events.title: 토트넘 홋스퍼 manager Keith Burkinshaw announces that he will resign as manager at the end of the season after nearly eight years in charge.
Peter Taylor resigns as manager of Second Division strugglers 더비 카운티, and is replaced on a caretaker basis by veteran player Roy McFarland .

The gap at the top of the First Division remains at two points as 리버풀 defeat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 6–0 at Anfield and 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 버밍엄 시티 1–0 at Old Trafford. 왓퍼드's improved form is interrupted by a 6–1 defeat at 노리치 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트 beat 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 3–1 at the City Ground but are still nine points off the top of the table with eight games left to play. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 move closer towards relegation with a 1–0 defeat at home to 노츠 카운티, whose own survival hopes are boosted. The Second Division's top three clubs 첼시, 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are level on 69 points at the top of the table, seven points ahead of fourth-placed 맨체스터 시티, with the Owls having two games in hand over their direct rivals.
울버햄프턴 원더러스 sack manager Graham Hawkins after just under two years in charge.
Thriving 아스널's hopes of breaking into the top five are dented when they are held to a 0–0 draw by 에버턴 at Goodison Park.

리버풀 beat Dinamo Bucharest 1–0 in the European Cup semi-final first leg at Anfield. 맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 1–1 at home to 유벤투스 in their first semi-final clash in the European Cup Winners' Cup. 토트넘 홋스퍼's hopes of reaching the UEFA Cup final are dented by a 2–1 defeat to Hajduk Split in Yugoslavia , but 노팅엄 포리스트 go 2–0 up in the first leg of their semi-final clash at home to 안더레흐트 .

에버턴 defeat 사우샘프턴 1–0 at Highbury in the FA Cup semi-finals to reach their first final for 16 years, while 왓퍼드 reach the FA Cup final for the first time ever with a 1–0 win over giantkilling 플리머스 아가일 at Villa Park . 리버풀 lose 2–0 at 스토크 시티 in the First Division, but 맨체스터 유나이티드 fail to take advantage and go down 1–0 at 노츠 카운티, allowing Joe Fagan 's men to stay on top. 노팅엄 포리스트 fail to take advantage of the top two's defeat, and are only able to manage a 2–2 draw away to an 입스위치 타운 side who are still in the bottom three. Down in the Second Division, 케임브리지 유나이티드 become the first team to be relegated this season, having won just two out of 36 games, while 스완지 시티 are now almost certain to suffer a second successive relegation.

맨체스터 유나이티드 squander another chance to go top of the First Division, being held to a goalless draw at 왓퍼드. 노팅엄 포리스트's title bid is fading fast as they go down 2–1 at 코번트리 시티. 사우샘프턴 beat 에버턴 3–1 at The Dell. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 keep up their bid for a UEFA Cup place with a 3–1 home win over 루턴 타운.

The gap at the top of the First Division now stands at two points after 리버풀 draw a thrilling game at Filbert Street 3–3 with 레스터 시티. 토트넘 홋스퍼 remain in the hunt for another top-five finish by beating 애스턴 빌라 2–1.

리버풀 beat 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 3–0 at Anfield in the First Division but 맨체스터 유나이티드 keep up the pressure on them with a 4–1 home win over 코번트리 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트's title challenge is practically over despite a 5–1 home win over 버밍엄 시티. 사우샘프턴 remain in with an outside chance of winning the title by beating 웨스트햄 유나이티드 2–0 at The Dell. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 lose 3–0 at home to 입스위치 타운, a result which boosts the Suffolk club's survival chances but leaves the hosts needing to win all six of their remaining games to have any chance of surviving even on goal difference.

울버햄프턴 원더러스 go down to the Second Division just one season after winning promotion, their relegation confirmed when they lose 2–0 to 에버턴 at Goodison Park. Their local rivals 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 take another step closer to survival by beating 선덜랜드 3–1 at The Hawthorns . 입스위치 타운 climb out of the bottom three by beating East Anglian rivals 노리치 시티 2–0 at Portman Road. In the Second Division, 맨체스터 시티's promotion hopes are left looking slim after they lose 3–2 at home to 허더즈필드 타운, meaning that 셰필드 웬즈데이 only need one point from their final six games to secure their return to the First Division after 14 years away. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's title hopes are also given a huge boost with a 5–1 home win over 칼라일 유나이티드.

리버풀 reach their fourth European Cup final in eight seasons with a 3–1 aggregate win over Dinamo Bucharest in the semi-finals. 맨체스터 유나이티드's hopes of European glory are ended when they lose their Cup Winners' Cup semi-final second leg 2–1 to 유벤투스 in Turin . 노팅엄 포리스트 suffer a spectacular 3–0 defeat to 안더레흐트 in their UEFA Cup semi-final second leg tie in Belgium , after winning the first leg 2–0, ending their hopes of an all-English UEFA Cup final clash with 토트넘 홋스퍼, who overcome Hajduk Split on away goals. 셰필드 웬즈데이's promotion celebrations are delayed by a 2–0 defeat to 미들즈브러 at Ayresome Park.

사우샘프턴 claim the biggest win of the First Division season with an 8–2 defeat of 코번트리 시티, with Steve Moran and Danny Wallace both scoring hat-tricks, keeping the Saints in contention for the title. 리버풀 are held to a 2–2 draw at home to 입스위치 타운, but 맨체스터 유나이티드 miss the chance to draw level on points with the leaders after 웨스트햄 유나이티드 hold them to a goalless draw at Old Trafford. QPR's faint hopes of winning the title are kept alive with a 2–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼. 셰필드 웬즈데이's promotion is confirmed by a 1–0 home win over 크리스털 팰리스, and are joined in the First Division next season by 첼시, who go up in style by beating 리즈 유나이티드 5–0 at home with top scorer Kerry Dixon scoring a hat-trick, although the Second Division title has yet to be decided. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 only need four points from their final three games to be sure of promotion.
